query: INSERT INTO channel_charges (conversation_id, channel_id, hop) SELECT w.conversation_id, w.channel_id, w.hop FROM channel_wakes w WHERE w.conversation_id = $1 AND w.key = (SELECT i.key FROM idempotency i WHERE i.conversation_id = $1 AND i.execution_status = 'delivered' ORDER BY i.updated_at DESC LIMIT 1) ORDER BY w.sent_at DESC LIMIT 1
